predecessors.name: Western Roman Empire
predecessors.text: Gaul, held 'for about two years' (Jovinus page), cut to the Western Roman Empire's 406 shape

successors.name: Western Roman Empire
successors.text: Gaul, held 'for about two years' (Jovinus page), cut to the Western Roman Empire's 406 shape

ledger.x: 411: Jovinus is proclaimed emperor at Mainz.

wars.name: Revolt of Jovinus
wars.outcome: Honorius and Ataulf's Visigoths defeated Jovinus's troops; Jovinus was captured at Valence and executed at Narbonne in 413.

certainty.note: The page names Gaul, Mainz, Valence and Narbonne; no boundary.
